manage_profiles_sets_hazard: Agents bind to sets by name — renaming or removing a set a live agent uses leaves its binding dangling until the next spawn resolves it.
manage_profiles_apply_desc: This will push the current profile registry to all live agents. Each agent rebuilds its failover state on its next wake-up.
manage_profiles_apply_desc_parked: {count} live agent(s) are running a now-parked profile and would be rebound to their set.
manage_profiles_unsaved_body: You have unsaved profile changes. Leaving this page now will discard them.
manage_profiles_save_stale_backend: The server is running an older build that cannot confirm dangling saves. Update the server, or remove the referenced set first.
manage_profiles_remove_provider_desc: Remove this provider from the draft. Profiles using it keep their model choices until you reassign them.
manage_profiles_provider_dialog_desc: Configure an LLM provider: family, base URL, and API key.
manage_profiles_provider_id_hint: Locked while editing — renaming would dangle every profile referencing it.
manage_profiles_provider_id_duplicate: This ID is already in use.
manage_profiles_provider_base_url_hint: Required for openai-compatible (e.g. https://host/v1); other families default to their official URL when empty.
manage_profiles_provider_api_key_hint_ed: Current: {mask}. Leave empty to keep, or type to replace.
manage_profiles_set_dialog_desc: Rename the set, describe it, and configure its failover profile list: order is priority, the first is active.
manage_profiles_set_dialog_name_taken: This name is already in use.
manage_profiles_set_dialog_no_providers: No providers defined yet — add one in the providers section first.
manage_profiles_set_drop_here: Drop to move into this set
manage_profiles_set_modalities_shadowed: Some members declare more modalities than the set supports; requests use the intersection.
manage_profiles_dangling_desc:
Saving will leave $count agent binding(s) pointing at a removed set:
$list

Save anyway, or cancel to keep editing.
manage_profiles_remove_set_confirm_desc: Agents bound to this set's name keep a dangling binding until their next spawn resolves it. Discard reverts this draft.
manage_profiles_remove_set_confirm_users: Bound agents ({users}) are interrupted and keep a dangling binding until rebound. The set is removed from the server immediately.
manage_profiles_sets_desc_l1: Profiles within a set fail over when one is unavailable
manage_profiles_sets_desc_l2: Each set is named; agents bind to a set by name at spawn
manage_profiles_sets_desc_l3: The default set backs the root agent and any spawn that names no set
manage_profiles_sets_desc_l4: Sets are unordered — selection is by name, not position
manage_profiles_parking_desc_l1: Parked profiles are out of rotation — the tagma never selects them
manage_profiles_parking_desc_l2: Drag a card into a set to enable it, or drag one here to park it
manage_profiles_parking_warn: {count} live agent(s) still run a parked profile: {ids}. Applying rebinds them to their set's active profile.
manage_profiles_parking_dialog_desc: Describe a profile without a set commitment; drag it into a set to enable it later.
manage_profiles_profile_dialog_desc: Edit this profile's provider, model, and context window.
manage_profiles_profile_dialog_id_duplic: This id is already used by a profile in a set or in parking
manage_profiles_profile_dialog_invalid_w: Enter a positive whole number of tokens.
manage_profiles_heading_desc_l1: Four layers: providers form a global pool; named sets rotate; parking holds draggable profile cards out of rotation
manage_profiles_heading_desc_l3: Profile Test = one minimal real inference
manage_profiles_source_proxy_banner: Profile source: the model gateway. The local snapshot is a cache; manage sets on the gateway admin page.
manage_profiles_source_degraded_body: The last refresh from the gateway failed; the page is serving the last good snapshot.
manage_profiles_source_poisoned_body: The platform no longer accepts this daemon. Enroll it again from the tagmata page; the pull resumes after the new enrollment.
manage_profiles_switch_entry_desc: This daemon is enrolled on this platform, so the profiles can come from the model gateway instead of the local file.
manage_profiles_switch_back_local: Switch back to the local file
manage_profiles_local_disk_absent: There is no readable local profiles.toml, so switching back has nothing to load.
manage_profiles_local_disk_pending: The local file preview is not available.
manage_profiles_switch_confirm_title_gat: Switch the profile source to the model gateway?
manage_profiles_switch_confirm_desc_gate:
The page becomes a read-only mirror. Manage sets on the gateway admin page.
The choice is saved in settings.toml and survives restarts.
The local profiles.toml stops receiving updates.
manage_profiles_switch_confirm_title_loc: Switch the profile source back to the local file?
manage_profiles_switch_confirm_desc_loca:
The page becomes the editor again.
The choice is saved in settings.toml and survives restarts.
Daemon restarts no longer contact the gateway.
manage_profiles_switch_failed: The source switch failed; nothing was switched.
manage_profiles_refetch_failed: The refetch failed; the snapshot was kept.
manage_profiles_local_disk_unreadable: The local file cannot be parsed: {error}
manage_profiles_gateway_collections_edit: Manage them on the gateway page
manage_profiles_gateway_collections_empt: No collections on the gateway account yet.
manage_profiles_connect_guide_body: This daemon needs a platform enrollment. Enroll it from the tagmata page of this platform; the gateway follows the platform. The gateway tab appears here once the enrollment is in place.
manage_profiles_selection_hint: Pick the one collection this daemon pulls. The pick takes effect on the next save or switch.
manage_profiles_selection_none: Nothing is pulled yet. Pick a collection below to pull its sets.
manage_profiles_rebind_body: The pull currently comes from another platform. Switching here moves it to this platform; the other side stops.
manage_profiles_unenrolled_body: This daemon is not enrolled on this platform's gateway. Enroll it from the tagmata page, then switch here.
manage_profiles_connect_guide_offline_bo: This direct shell has no platform context, so the gateway tab stays hidden here. Open the online shell on your platform to connect the model gateway.
